title: Start November as a Contiguous Canonical Range
teaser: Every calendar day in the new shard must appear exactly once.
full_text: Build the November 2035 shard from November 1 through November 30 and verify dates are contiguous and unique.

title: Separate Local-Day Identity from UTC Date
teaser: Daily selection must follow the user's canonical civil day rather than a raw UTC date.
full_text: Create timezone fixtures crossing midnight and verify daily content resolves from local date identity.

title: Pin Delta T Provenance in Calculation Manifests
teaser: Astronomy output should disclose which time-scale data produced it.
full_text: Store Delta T provider version and provenance ID in the calculation manifest and verify the fixture is reproducible.

title: Expose Unsupported Placidus Conditions Explicitly
teaser: High-latitude failures must not be hidden behind fabricated house values.
full_text: Trigger a Placidus failure at an extreme latitude and verify the domain returns the contracted fallback or unsupported result.

title: Count Destructive Changes in Restore Preview
teaser: Replace restore should show its impact before applying it.
full_text: Open a fixture where current and backup datasets differ and verify preview counts records to add update and delete correctly.

title: Validate Backup Checksums Before Mutation
teaser: Corrupted archives must not write partial data into the database.
full_text: Load a backup fixture with a modified payload checksum and verify integrity validation stops restore before any transaction begins.

title: Test PDF Pagination with Long Commentary
teaser: Large interpretation blocks must not overlap footers or following sections.
full_text: Render a report containing several long text blocks and verify pages contain no clipping overlap or lost content.

title: Preserve Persisted Identity Across Locale Changes
teaser: Changing language must not rewrite stable IDs or calculation state.
full_text: Create a profile in Turkish then open it in English and verify stable enum IDs plus calculation snapshot hashes remain unchanged.

title: Honor Verified Lifetime PRO Ownership Offline
teaser: A previously verified permanent purchase should remain usable without network access.
full_text: Cold-start in airplane mode with valid cached lifetime ownership and verify protected PRO features remain available.

title: Route Invalid Deep Links to a Safe State
teaser: Malformed parameters must not crash the app or bypass authorization.
full_text: Open deep-link fixtures with missing profile IDs and invalid feature parameters and verify they resolve to a safe error or landing screen.

title: Define Backup Behavior for Soft-Deleted Records
teaser: Export scope for tombstones must be deterministic and documented.
full_text: Create active and soft-deleted records then verify backup manifest and payload follow the contracted tombstone policy exactly.

title: Keep Focus Traversal Aligned with Visual Order
teaser: Keyboard and assistive focus should not jump unpredictably around forms.
full_text: Traverse the profile form through semantics focus and verify the order matches the visual reading flow.

title: Measure Contrast for Disabled and Muted States
teaser: Accessibility checks must include more than enabled primary controls.
full_text: Evaluate theme tokens in active disabled error and muted states and fail validation for combinations below the required contrast threshold.

title: Preserve Coordinate Precision Through Persistence
teaser: Location data must not be rounded early enough to alter calculations.
full_text: Persist a high-precision latitude longitude fixture reload it and verify the calculation layer receives values within the contracted precision.

title: Record Timezone Database Version with Results
teaser: Historical offset calculations should be traceable to a specific tzdb release.
full_text: Calculate a historical DST fixture and verify the calculation manifest records the timezone database version used.

title: Fail Closed Outside the Ephemeris Coverage Range
teaser: Bundled astronomy data must not silently extrapolate beyond its supported span.
full_text: Calculate fixtures just outside both supported date boundaries and verify the provider returns an explicit out-of-range result.

title: Enforce Symmetry in the Aspect Grid
teaser: A-B and B-A cells must represent the same relationship.
full_text: Generate a multi-planet natal grid and verify mirrored non-diagonal cells have identical aspect identity and orb values.

title: Keep Chaldean Mapping Independent of UI Locale
teaser: Numeric letter mapping must not change because interface labels changed.
full_text: Calculate one canonical name under Turkish and English UI locales and verify the Chaldean result is identical.

title: Keep Hidden Stems in Deterministic Order
teaser: Repeated rendering of the same pillar must not reorder hidden stems.
full_text: Build known Four Pillars fixtures and verify hidden stems preserve the canonical strength order on every run.

title: Require Manifest Updates When Asset Hashes Change
teaser: A modified runtime asset must not ship under a stale integrity record.
full_text: Change a versioned test asset and verify the asset validator fails until the manifest hash is updated.

title: Explain Offline Location Search Boundaries
teaser: Missing network coverage should not look like an unexplained search failure.
full_text: In airplane mode query one bundled location and one outside the offline index then verify the UI clearly distinguishes offline coverage limits.

title: Handle Database Integrity Failures Without Crash Loops
teaser: Corrupted local state should enter controlled recovery.
full_text: Cold-start with a fixture containing checksum or foreign-key corruption and verify the app transitions into the documented safe recovery flow.

title: Measure Cold Start in Release Profile
teaser: Debug startup timing is not representative of production performance.
full_text: Measure clean-install and populated-database cold starts in release profile and fail the performance gate when the documented budget is exceeded.

title: Redact Birth Data from Diagnostic Logs
teaser: Crash and debug output must not expose sensitive profile fields.
full_text: Trigger an error fixture containing name birth date time and coordinates and verify the log sink redacts those values.

title: Keep Sensitive Fields Out of PDF Metadata
teaser: Invisible document properties must not leak tokens or internal paths.
full_text: Generate a professional PDF then inspect metadata and embedded properties to verify only approved title author and date fields remain.

title: Neutralize Spreadsheet Formula Injection in CSV
teaser: User text that begins like a formula must export safely.
full_text: Export note fixtures beginning with equals plus minus and at-sign characters and verify the contracted spreadsheet-injection protection is applied.

title: Preserve PIN Fallback When Biometrics Are Cancelled
teaser: Cancelling biometric authentication must not trap the user at the lock screen.
full_text: Cancel the biometric prompt in a configured fixture and verify PIN fallback remains accessible without weakening authorization boundaries.

title: Relock Sensitive Screens After Background Timeout
teaser: Protected client information should not remain exposed after a long background period.
full_text: Background a protected client detail screen past the configured timeout then resume and verify reauthentication is required.

title: Audit November by Compound Date and Locale Key
teaser: A duplicate day or cross-locale row must not enter a shard unnoticed.
full_text: Validate November Turkish and English shards by date-locale key and fail audit on duplicate missing or wrong-locale rows.

title: Close November Coverage from Committed Main Evidence
teaser: Editorial counts should advance only after canonical shards are reloaded from main.
full_text: Reload both November shards from main verify thirty exact records per locale and record December 1 2035 as the next start.
